name: Summarise a document into a note
description: Reads a document, makes a short local summary, and saves it as a note.
when_to_use: Use it when you want the main points of a report, article, or other file in your notes.
goal: Summarise a document and save a useful note.

config.source: Set this to the document you want to summarise, for example $HOME/Documents/report.txt
